skills.description: AI-powered indoor plant light stress detection from smart planter or fixed camera images (optionally combined with light sensor lux data). Combined with optional lux sensor readings, it determines the current light stress type (insufficient / excessive / normal) and outputs adjustment suggestions (e.g. move to window, add shading, adjust grow-light duration).
